routes.title: Bas Ek Pin / The Backstage Department
routes.plain_concept: She says she is almost ready, then one tiny outfit emergency turns Zuv into the calm backstage department: safety pin, dupatta edge, phone, bag, keys, and the final little rescue before they leave.
routes.universal_truth: Some love does not wait at the door for you to become easy; it joins the tiny backstage panic.
routes.aachu_spark: Expressive last-minute outfit panic, exacting eye, dramatic but real desi getting-ready urgency.
routes.zuv_role: He does not rush or lecture. He holds, finds, steadies, and becomes useful inside the scene.
routes.proof_beat: Safety pin or dupatta/pallu emergency with his hands visibly holding the situation together.

routes.title: Aachu Dictionary
